arStrings.szText: "Everyone is telling you to give up this quest for the Sightless Eye. Maybe you should listen."
Spoken like someone who can choose to walk away. The visions will not end. I did not ask for sight. I am a Seer because my mother was one, and her mother’s mothers.
Only fools think this is a gift. To sense, but not see. To know, but not understand. I need to see all! I’ll go mad if I don’t.
